title: Semigroups from full lattices in commutative ${\mathbb Q}$-algebras
summary: The full lattices in a finite dimensional commutative ${\mathbb Q}$-algebra form a commutative semigroup. In the case of an algebraic number field the top part of a certain quotient semigroup is the class group. For a separable algebra some basic results, especially the Jordan-Zassenhaus theorem, are known for this quotient semigroup. This paper considers also algebras which are not separable.
